feel: Reduced textures, bright picture, 125 fps cap

provenance.changes: 99 of 310 lines were left out: chat lines, passwords and logins, the player’s name, file paths and hardware details, server hosting settings, timed key macros, settings of other games and settings the game protects.

story: configs.eu lists this file under TEK9. The hardware it names suggests 2005 to 2008; the page gives no date. Sensitivity can’t be compared between players without the mouse’s DPI, which the file doesn’t give.
